title: PlantDiseaseTreatmentProfile
description: Schema for structured disease advisory data decoupled from the CNN model

disease_name.description: Standardized scientific and common disease name

symptoms.description: Visual symptoms observed on foliage, stem, or fruit

cultural_treatment.description: Non-chemical cultural management practices (e.g. sanitation, crop rotation)

chemical_treatment.description: Verified agronomic chemical or biological treatments (expert vetted)

safety_notes.description: Agricultural safety precautions, application timing, and PPE recommendations

source.description: Verified agricultural extension service or academic reference
